name: ALB Role Visibility for Enfold
author: Onur Kurtic

sections.description:
Adds per-element role visibility controls to Enfold’s Avia Layout Builder.

Features

  • Adds a “Visibility” tab to ALB elements.
  • Supports all WordPress roles, including custom roles.
  • Supports guest targeting (not logged in users).
  • Works at element level (e.g. text blocks, sections, nested items).

Usage

  1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. Edit any ALB element.
  3. Open the “Visibility” tab.
  4. Set:
    • Element Visibility
    • User Roles

Notes

  • Users with edit capabilities (e.g. admins/editors) are bypassed by default so they can always see content while editing.
  • If you use full-page caching, configure cache variation by login/role.
